source.title: Anthropic Engineers Reveal How to Build AI Agents with Claude Opus 5.5
source.description:
Anthropic engineers are sharing how modern AI agents are built — and why Claude Opus 5.5 changes the way developers approach agentic systems.

From agent architecture and context management to memory graphs, autonomous loops, orchestration and reverse engineering, this technical session explores what it takes to build more capable AI agents.

Topics covered:
- Claude Managed Agents and agent architecture
- Building an Opus 5.5-powered agent
- Skills, loops and memory systems
- Context resets and agent harness design
- Agent dreaming and orchestration
- Reverse engineering with Claude agents

Referenced session timestamps:
00:00 — Introduction to Claude Managed Agents  
07:45 — Opus 5.5 architecture  
23:40 — Skills, loops and memory graphs  
54:00 — Agent dreaming and orchestration  
1:10:23 — Reverse engineering


Subscribe to Next Gen Breakthroughs for AI engineering, automation, developer tools and emerging technology.
